title: Decode the Exit Status
prompt: POSIX. `run_exit_status(code)` (given) forks a child that exits with `code` and returns the raw waitpid status word. Implement `int decode_exit(int status)` returning the child's exit code if it exited normally, or -1 if it did not exit normally. Remember: exit codes are the low 8 bits.

tests.name: normal exit
tests.hint: WIFEXITED holds and WEXITSTATUS extracts the low byte: 7.

tests.name: zero exit
tests.hint: Success is exit code 0 — the exact value every script tests.

tests.name: truncation to 8 bits
tests.hint: _exit(256) keeps only the low 8 bits: 256 = 0x100, low byte 0.
